facts.fact: 医院没装点万圣节，可 Spellman 七楼挤满了鬼像在开派对；她想：这些是被他们放出来的，还是一直都在、只是应景。
facts.anchor: The hospital was not decorated for Halloween, but Spellman 7 was packed with ghosts, like a party. I wondered if they were the ghosts we had freed or if they were always there and just feeling festive.

facts.fact: 她感觉储存库的电流落到了村里、点亮了病房：床上没有一个人是独自躺着，所有人都醒着。
facts.anchor: It felt like the electricity from the storage unit had settled over the Village and had energized the ward. No one in bed was by themselves, and everyone was awake.

facts.fact: 她牵起 Bianca 的手问：你看见他们吗？Bianca 答：也许跟你不一样，但我看见了。（此前只有 Bianca 一只耳朵的人承认过）
facts.anchor: She looked around carefully. “Maybe not like you do. But yeah. I see them.”

facts.fact: Star 还不能走不能说，但睁开好眼、像在试着微笑；她的房间是唯一一间「满是美丽女人」的——身着华服的美丽女鬼，正如 Star 梦想穿的，围着所有人照拂。
facts.anchor: Star wasn’t walking or talking much yet, but her good eye was open, and it looked like she was trying to smile. Hers was the only room I saw that was filled with beautiful women, beautiful ghosts in beautiful gowns just like Star dreamed of wearing, doting on and fussing over everyone.

facts.fact: 她对 Star 说：等你出院，搬来和我住，行吗？
facts.anchor: “Star,” I said. “When you leave here, I want you to move in with me, okay?”

facts.fact: 她说实话有点怕：家里再有一个病人、再看一遍全过程；但这是她唯一能做的事。（她还想到 Mark 的东西 Star 会喜欢：书、银片裙。）
facts.anchor: Honestly, I was a little scared of it, having someone else who was sick in my house and watching it all happen again. But it was the only thing I could do.

facts.fact: Bianca 给 Star 系上黑丝巾：「今年你可以扮 Little Edie（《灰色花园》）。要点胭脂吗？」——补上 ch33 未办成的主题。
facts.anchor: Bianca took a black silk scarf out of her purse and wrapped it around Star’s head. “You can be Little Edie this year. You want a little rouge?”

facts.fact: 她对 Claude 说：我本希望今晚能见到你。
facts.anchor: “I was hoping I’d see you tonight.”

facts.fact: 她像第一次在 Paradise Garage 舞池钓她那样吻她——开放而满——因为当时放的是这首歌（女孩版本），此刻又放着，为她们而放。
facts.anchor: I kissed her the way I did the first time, when I cruised her on the dance floor of the Paradise Garage, open and full, because this was the song that was playing then—the girl version, though—and it was playing now, for us.

facts.fact: 她对她耳语：我一直没能面对自己有多需要人——对不起，我想认真对待我们。
facts.anchor: I haven’t been able to deal with how much I need people,” I said. “I’m sorry. I’d like to take us seriously.”

facts.fact: Star 床头的钟：过了午夜——她在开启新十年。
facts.anchor: There was a clock above Star’s bed. It was after midnight—I was starting a new decade.

facts.fact: 她的生日：三十岁；Claude 笑说「很好，我不再约会二十几岁的人了」。
facts.anchor: Her beautiful smile. “That’s good. I’m over dating someone in her twenties.”

facts.fact: Bianca 提议带 Star 出去透透气；Claude 探头对走廊喊：「Bev，我带 712 去做 CT。」（用医疗借口放行）。
facts.anchor: Claude poked her head out the door. “Bev, I’m taking 712 out for a CAT scan.”
